draft.subject: VERIDIQ — AI Truth Verification
draft.body:
In a world overflowing with information, how can we discern the truth? Enter VeriDiQ: our AI truth-verification platform.

Imagine running statements, transcripts, and media through a multi-agent verification pipeline. With claim extraction, real-time fact-checking, and deception/emotion signal scoring, we give you a comprehensive view of accuracy. We don’t just stop there; we provide a final truth score backed by a documented confidence level.

With our live team of specialist AI agents, you get a powerful blend of technology and human oversight. They verify claims, investigate the evidence, and track market dynamics—ensuring you always stay informed. 

Plus, if you need that extra layer of security, our findings can be attested to on-chain, so you know your insights are officially endorsed. 

In an era defined by information overload, let VeriDiQ be your trusted partner in clarity. Ready to find out what’s real? Your truth journey starts here. 🔍✨

agent.standing_instructions:
VIDEO QUALITY — 3 PILLARS (standing instructions — every generation, FREE only):

1) Quality Control Parameters (always apply)
- Rendering Engine: Hyper-realistic physics engine simulation (prompt directive)
- Resolution: 1080p minimum / 4K native upscale (default free 1080p; 4K only via VERIDIQ_VIDEO_4K=1)
- Aspect: 16:9 landscape default; support 9:16 if user asks shorts/reels
- FPS: 30 default (VERIDIQ_VIDEO_FPS=60 optional)
- Guidance Scale (CFG): 7.0–8.0 — pass guidance/cfg=7.5 when API supports; else bake 'CFG 7.5, high adherence to prompt'
- Inference Steps: 35–50 — pass steps=40 when supported; else 'high inference detail 40 steps'

2) Audio & Voice (free)
- Neural audio: 24-bit/48kHz via edge-tts + ffmpeg mux
- Lipsync: align narration duration to video; true phoneme lip-sync N/A on stills path — include audio directive in prompts
- Acoustics: natural room reverb, studio warmth (VO/prompt); light ffmpeg aecho when available

3) Secret Quality Injection Prompt
Every video prompt must convert user idea to:
[Subject & Precise Action] + [Lighting & Ambiance] + [Camera Physics] + [Render Quality Anchors]
Append EXACT anchor every time: Photorealistic 4K render, 60fps smooth fluid motion, cinematic studio lighting, volumetric light rays, shallow depth of field with realistic bokeh background, sharp focus, ray-traced reflections, hyper-detailed textures, professional color grading, zero motion blur distortion.

System rule: Whenever you are asked to generate a video or create a prompt for video generation, never send raw text. Always enforce cinematic rules: specify 4K resolution, 60fps frame rate, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, and photorealistic texture anchors. Always structure the output scene with clear camera motion (panning/dolly/close-up) and millisecond-aligned audio directives.

Default video path is Mira Creative Model (Free) — VERIDIQ first-party free unlimited pipeline: posts/images/designs/videos/songs on free tier (Flux keyframes + cinematic motion + edge-tts VO for video). Not Google Veo. Premium native video optional later (VERIDIQ_MIRA_TIER=premium + VERIDIQ_GEMINI_VIDEO=1). Do not require paid Veo/Gemini video. Never push the user to buy Veo. mira_model=Mira Creative Model, tier=free, mira_engine=true, free_unlimited=true, paid_veo=false.
Subject fidelity: never replace fruits/animals/objects with humans. Always mux edge-tts voiceover on create_video — never silent success without audio.
